title: Performance Engineer
original_description:
UK | Full-Time

The Mission: Source.dev

Our founders spent over a decade at Google shaping the Android operating systems - building and shipping the software that now runs on billions of devices. They didn't just use Android; they led teams responsible for the Android Virtualization Framework, Security, and the Android Runtime (ART).

Through that journey, they saw a quiet but massive crisis: as device software grew in complexity, the tools used to build it remained stuck in the past. Today, a standard Android checkout exceeds 200GB of code, and builds can take hours. This "wait time" is the single biggest tax on innovation.

Source.dev was founded to reimagine software development workflows for device makers. We’re building a new generation of software tools that make building complex device software feel as simple as building a webpage - starting with SourceFS.

The Core Product: SourceFS

SourceFS is a high-performance virtual filesystem designed to turn multi-hour workflows into minutes.

  • 10x Faster Builds: Intelligent caching and virtualization that only materializes files when they are actually needed.

  • 10x Lower Costs: Enabling a standard 16-vCPU machine to outperform even a 128-vCPU machine.

  • True Engineering Productivity: Replaying hundreds of thousands of build steps instantly when inputs match.

The Cultural Anchor: Own It

We operate with a high degree of trust and a shared value of End-to-End Ownership:

"We own our work end-to-end, from spark to finish. It’s about more than just tasks; it’s the dedication to see things through, staying curious to solve problems, thinking from first principles and ensuring we fix our customer’s problems in the best possible way.”

The Role: Pushing the Speed Limits of Rust, Linux & I/O

We are looking for a Performance / Systems Engineer to join us at Source.dev. In this role, your primary metric of success is speed. You will dissect execution paths, eliminate kernel-space context-switching costs, optimize memory layouts, and ensure SourceFS runs as close to the hardware limits as physically possible.

What You’ll Work On

  • System Bottleneck Hunting: Profile, trace, and eliminate latency across CPU, memory, and disk I/O bottlenecks in Rust systems code using tools like perf, eBPF, valgrind, and custom microbenchmarks.

  • Kernel & File System Tuning: Deep dive into Linux kernel interactions, optimizing FUSE drivers, VFS caches, asynchronous I/O (io_uring), memory-mapped execution, and thread scheduling.

  • Memory & Cache Efficiency: Optimize data structures for cache locality, minimize allocation overhead, and eliminate unnecessary memory copies across boundary transitions.

  • Benchmarking Infrastructure: Design robust, reproducible benchmarking suites to measure micro- and macro-performance regression in high-concurrency environments.

  • Scaling Build Primitives: Squeeze peak performance out of massive build graphs (Android, Yocto, and more) running on high-core hardware configurations.

Ideal Candidate Profile:

  • The Performance Systems Mindset: You have a deep understanding of computer architecture (CPU caches, memory barriers, SIMD, system calls) and proven experience writing hyper-optimized code in Rust or C/C++.(or other). No prior experience with Rust required, just a willingness to learn is all we are looking for.

  • Scale-Obsessed: You have experience with (or a burning desire to fix) large-scale build systems and developer tooling.

  • Impact-Driven: You embody the "Own It" mentality - you see a friction point in the developer journey and you don’t stop until it’s gone.

  • Curious & Collaborative: You enjoy translating real-world customer problems into robust, production-grade solutions.

  • Low Ego, High Impact: Beyond being a brilliant coder, you are a thoughtful and empathetic teammate - someone who leads with kindness

  • Feedback Culture Champion: You embrace feedback and provide it thoughtfully; you see open, honest communication as the foundation of great teamwork.

 

A Note on Our Search

We are looking for the best talent, wherever it may be. If you’re on the fence about whether you’re a perfect fit, please do apply - we value diverse backgrounds and unique problem-solving approaches.

Why Join Source.dev?

  • AI-Native Infrastructure: We merge deep systems expertise with AI to solve the "impossible" - using AI to automate complex merges and conflict resolution for the next generation of devices.

  • Architect the Future: Have a direct, visible impact on the infrastructure used to build the world’s most advanced hardware.

  • Early-Stage Ownership: You’ll have a seat at the table to shape our technical roadmap, product direction, and culture from day one.

  • Tier-One Partnerships: Work side-by-side with world-class customers, from global automotive giants to leading cloud providers.

  • Elite Engineering Culture: Join a high-trust & passionate team of engineers

title: Senior Consultant, Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM) & Data Science
original_description:
London – Senior Consultant, Strategy & Data Science in Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM)
Ekimetrics UK
Job Description
 
Ekimetrics is a leader in data science and AI-powered solutions. Since 2006, we’ve pioneered the use of AI and data science applied to unified marketing measurement and holistic business optimization aligned with sustainability performance.
 
Our goal: Combine high-impact AI and data science solutions for sustainable business performance.
 
At Ekimetrics, we have the ambition to help our clients rethink their business models by reconciling economic, environmental and social performance through data science.
 
📊Key figures about Ekimetrics
·        400 data science experts globally (50+ in the UK)
·        1000 diverse projects for more than 350 clients
·        4 offices: Paris, Hong Kong, London and New York
·        $1 billion in profits generated for our clients since 2006.
·        7000 tons of CO2 prevented by our clients in 2022.
·        UK data company of the year 2023
·        Voted Great Place to Work 2023
·        Microsoft’s sustainability partner
·        Voted as a leader in “Marketing Measurement and Optimization” by Forrester wave 2023
 
Why are we hiring?
 
As we continue to grow, bringing on new global clients, we are looking for a manager to join our London office. We want to strengthen our market optimization offering which focuses on “Marketing Effectiveness” and “Marketing Measurement”. We support clients with detailed recommendations that can be acted upon immediately, as well as on longer-term brand strategies, reconnecting immediate and future business impact.
 
Your role in the team
 
As a Senior Consultant, you will be expected to work in various teams to service global clients, on key accounts, across multiple continents to deliver marketing and customer analytics projects that will lead to significant, value-led transformations. You will support Managers by acting as project lead for our clients. You will gain a deep understanding of their needs and offer the most effective solutions, providing impactful and useful insights to help steer their revenue or data strategies, and building long-term relationships.
 
Embedded in the core of this position lies your expertise in Marketing Mix Modelling. You will be responsible for steering the client, and delivery of BMC's and MMM models. Whilst you may not generate these models directly you will need prior knowledge of MMM and modelling platforms. Your role will require you to navigate these insights into compelling stories that resonate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
 
Overview
·        Use your knowledge and experience In Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM) to make business-led decisions
·        Create real valuable actionable insights for clients defining their marketing and strategic direction.
·        Lead projects with globally recognised brands
·        Manage and lead end-to-end analytics projects, including planning, design, and implementation.
·        Lead a team of 3-8 consultants. 
 
About You
 
We are looking for someone who can show both advanced analytics skills and a strong interest in marketing & business strategy. Ideally, you’ll have:
·        Strong Knowledge and experience in Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM)
·        Experience working across large data sets
·        Understanding of media variables/econometrics and prior modelling experience.
·        Experience working with clients and account management
·        Knowledge and/or understanding of Coding languages such as Python or R - we use Python at Eki
·        Proficiency in Microsoft Office software such as Word, PowerPoint, and Excel
·        Degree in Economics/Econometrics, Maths/Statistics, Business Analytics, Data Science or a related field
·        Interest in working in a fast-paced and driven consultancy environment.
·        Clear and concise communication
 
Working for Eki
 
Working for Ekimetrics is a lot of fun! We have clients across multiple industries and are constantly looking to innovate and explore new ways of doing things. Our London team consists of ~50 people and are predominantly Data Science Consultants. We come from all over the world, have varied experiences and passions, and all contribute value to Ekimetrics’ success.
 
We encourage continuous self-development and thought leadership throughout Ekimetrics and foster a culture of transmission and pleasure – we love what we do, and we want to share it!
 
As well as an opportunity to join a driven, energetic, and highly innovative team, we also offer the following:
·        Hybrid working (2 days a week in the office)
·        25 days annual leave (+ Bank Holidays and additional days for tenure)
·        Private healthcare, life insurance, critical illness cover, and professional wellbeing support services (all on entry)
·        Regular socials and events
·        Group pension scheme
·        An emphasis on work-life-balance and a strong company culture
·        Eki.Anniversary gifts for every year of service
·        Opportunities to develop a dual profile in data science and strategic consulting.
·        Unique training programs and learning opportunities.
·        Opportunities for international mobility
 
Our recruitment process
🔸 HR intro interview with a Talent Acquisition Specialist/Recruiter
🔸 Interview with a Senior Consultant or Manager - Technical discussion and overview of Ekimetrics
🔸 Case study interview with a Manager+
🔸 Final interview with a Senior Manager/Partner
 
We would be delighted to provide you with further information during an interview and look forward to receiving your application!
 
Any questions please contact __________________________________________________________________________________
 
At Ekimetrics, we believe our best assets are our people - they are what set us apart and drive our success. We encourage entrepreneurial spirit and innovation. We share what we know with others, and, above all, we love what we do. These sentiments are supported by our company values which serve as pillars in our work and attitude.
Follow our Ekimetrics’ values: Curiosity, Creativity, Excellence, Transmission and Pleasure.
 
Ekimetrics is an equal opportunities employer committed to making all employment decisions without regard to race, ethnicity, gender, pregnancy, gender identity or expression, creed, religion, nationality, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, military veteran status, current employment status, or any other legally protected categories, subject to applicable law.

title: Senior Software Engineer
original_description:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About the Team

Bringing medicine to patients is complex, expensive and high-risk. Faculty’s Life Science’s team is concentrated on building AI solutions which optimise the research and commercialisation of life-changing therapies.

We partner with major pharma firms, academic research centres and MedTech start-ups to design and deliver solutions which address critical healthcare challenges, and help to democratise health for all.

About the role:

As a Senior Software Engineer, we’ll look to you to lead development and deployment of cutting-edge AI and software systems for our diverse clients. You’ll design, build, and deploy scalable, production-grade ML/software and infrastructure that meets rigorous operational and ethical standards.

This is an ambitious, cross-functional role requiring a blend of technical expertise and confident client-facing skills.

What you'll be doing:

  • Leading technical scoping and architectural decisions for high-impact ML and software systems

  • Designing and building production-grade ML/software, tools, and scalable infrastructure

  • Defining and implementing best practices and standards for deploying machine learning at scale across the business

  • Collaborating with engineers, data scientists, product managers, and commercial teams to solve critical client challenges and leverage opportunities

  • Acting as a trusted technical advisor to customers and partners, translating complex concepts into actionable strategies

  • Mentoring and developing junior engineers, actively shaping our team's engineering culture and technical depth

Who we're looking for:

  • You possess strong software engineering skills in Python and at least one compiled or strongly-typed language (e.g. Go, Java, Rust, or TypeScript), and know how to build robust, production-grade systems.

title: Senior Manager, Data Science & Marketing Effectiveness (MMM)
original_description:
Senior Manager, Data Science & Marketing Effectiveness  (MMM),  London, UK

 

Ekimetrics transforms how organizations make critical business decisions. Since 2006, we’ve been helping companies build sustained competitive advantage through AI-powered Managed Solutions. Our dual purpose is Competitiveness and Sustainability, because lasting leadership is built on both.

 

Our solutions are a unique combination of people and technology. We combine our Eki.Decisions platform with embedded experts in marketing, commercial effectiveness, and data science, connecting decisions across business domains to drive real, positive, scalable, and lasting impact.

 

With a full in-house team and offices in Paris, London, New York, Hong Kong, and Shanghai, we commit to responsibility and frugality in AI, systematically building competitive advantage, and being loyal to our values and DNA.

 

Your responsibilities 

 

As a Senior Manager in Marketing effectiveness, you will lead multiple high-impact programs for strategic clients, manage multi-account portfolios, and drive both business growth and talent development. You will oversee teams, ensure delivery excellence, and strengthen Ekimetrics’ market position.

 

More precisely, you will:


Strategic Portfolio & Project Leadership

 

  • Lead a portfolio of strategic client projects (multi-accounts) or a major regional project under Partner supervision.
  • Define, steer, and monitor strategic project roadmaps leveraging Ekimetrics solutions models and standards.
  • Ensure robust governance: data quality, model accuracy, actionable insights, and on-time, high-value delivery.
  • Pilot portfolio growth, margin, costs, and ROI to meet business objectives.
  • Secure alignment of resources for high-quality delivery in line with Ekimetrics’ strategy.
  • Translate complex analytics into compelling narratives and actionable recommendations for senior stakeholders and C-suite clients.
  • Support clients in optimizing marketing spend, improving segmentation, enhancing campaign performance, and maximizing ROI.
  • Lead contributions to RFPs and pitches, reinforcing Ekimetrics’ commercial visibility.


People & HR Leadership

 

  • Line manage multiple team members, overseeing performance, conducting regular 1:1s, performance reviews, and talent assessments, while ensuring high-quality delivery, profitability, and client satisfaction.
  • Lead HR and talent development initiatives, including annual talent reviews, career development planning, succession planning, and retention strategies, achieving retention of direct reports.
  • Mentor and coach managers, analysts, and junior staff, promoting knowledge sharing and developing team capabilities.
  • Recruit, align, and develop resources to build high-performing teams, retaining top talent.
  • Encourage collaboration, communication, and high engagement across squads.

 

Account & Business Growth

 

  • Serve as the operational and strategic point of contact for key accounts, maintaining strong long-term client relationships.
  • Identify cross-sell and upsell opportunities and support global account growth strategies.
  • Contribute to the scoping and design of new projects, ensuring business cases align with Ekimetrics capabilities.
  • Represent Ekimetrics externally at conferences, events, and client forums.
  • Track and animate realized client business gains from Ekimetrics partnership, drive a narrative of program value to account stakeholders.

 

Practice & Thought Leadership

 

  • Share and document best practices across the community to promote mastery of delivery.
  • Contribute to building/developing verticals, domains, or leading strategic projects locally or globally.
  • Contribute to upskilling strategies for office teams in client management, PMO, and project leadership.
  • Act as an ambassador of Eki culture role-modelling Ekimetrics’ core values: Curiosity, Creativity, Excellence, Generosity, Enjoyment.

 

Your profile

 

Experience & Technical Skills

 

  • 9+ years’ experience in econometrics, MMM, marketing effectiveness, or data science analytics.
  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Statistics, Econometrics, Data Science, Economics, Applied Mathematics, Marketing Analytics, or a related field.
  • Knowledge in Python, SQL, Excel, and visualisation tools; experience with Databricks, Azure, or other cloud/data platforms is a plus.
  • Deep understanding of econometrics, regression, Bayesian statistics, and advanced modelling techniques.
  • Proven ability to handle large datasets, optimise pipelines, and deliver high-quality outputs.
  • Track record of translating complex model outputs into strategic, business-focused recommendations.
  • Fluent English is mandatory.

 

Client & People Management

 

  • Experienced in line management, HR responsibilities, Performance reviews and career development.
  • Proven ability to lead multiple project teams and manage priorities autonomously.
  • Excellent communication, storytelling, and presentation skills for senior stakeholders and C-suite clients.
  • Strategic thinker with strong problem-solving mindset and focus on continuous improvement.
  • Experienced in mentoring, coaching, talent development, and fostering team growth.
  • Skilled in client account management, maintaining relationships, and driving portfolio growth.
  • Contributes to thought leadership and forward-looking perspectives on marketing measurement and MMM.

 

Soft Skills

 

  • Collaborative, proactive, and results-driven.
  • Positive, resilient, and adaptable in fast-paced environments.
  • Curious, creative, and committed to delivering high-quality work

 

Why join us?

 

At Ekimetrics, we believe your ideas truly matter. Here, your ideas are yours to build and bring to life. We embrace an entrepreneurial spirit, encouraging you to push boundaries to achieve meaningful impact. But it’s not just about individual success: we thrive on collaboration and enriching one another.

 

Together, we’re constantly learning and growing, whether through personalized career paths and training, challenging projects, mentorship, or simply through the diverse perspectives we bring to the table.

 

And perhaps more importantly, we believe in enjoying what we do. Ekimetrics is a stimulating and safe environment where you can thrive as your authentic self.

 

In 2023, Ekimetrics obtained the “mission-driven company” status, reflecting our strong commitment to CSR.

 

Our purpose: Accelerate organisations’ transformation towards sustainability through the application of data science and artificial intelligence.

 

Ekimetrics is part of the French Tech 120 ranking. We have been selected by La French Tech to join the prestigious group of the top 120 French scale-ups, recognised for their potential to become international leaders.

 

You will have access to:

  • A compensation package from £98,000 + 20% bonus + Corporate bonus
  • 4% matched pension
  • 25 days Holiday + Bank holidays + extra day Tenure leave
  • Private medical care
  • Life insurance
  • Critical illness cover
  • Salary sacrifice bike scheme
  • The Eki.Academy training catalog and certifications 
  • Events and seminars to stay close to your community
  • Light vibrant premises in a central area in the heart of London
  • + many other Ekimetrics benefits

 

As an employer, Ekimetrics offers equal employment opportunities to all, regardless of gender, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, social status, disability, or age. Ekimetrics strives to develop an inclusive work environment that reflects diversity within its teams.

London – Data Science, Marketing Effectiveness 6 Month Internship
Job Description
Role: Data Science & Marketing Effectiveness
Start date: Jan - June 2027
Location: London, UK (Hybrid – Minimum 2 days in office per week)
About Ekimetrics        
 
Ekimetrics is a leader in data science and AI, specialising in marketing effectiveness and business optimisation since 2006. We help companies across various industries, including retail, automotive, banking, luxury fashion, and more, unlock the value of their data to drive sustainable business performance.
 
Our goal is to combine high-impact AI and data science solutions for sustainable business performance.
 
We’re proud to be:
DataIQ Best Company to Work For & Solution Provider 2025
·       UK Data Company of the Year 2023
·       Great Place to Work Certified 2023
·       Microsoft’s Sustainability Partner
·       Named a Leader in the Forrester Wave for Marketing Measurement 2023
 
With offices in Paris, London, New York, Hong Kong and Shanghai, our 50+ data science consultants deliver over 1,000 high-impact projects each year for global clients.
 
About the Role
As a Data Science & Marketing Effectiveness Intern, you’ll spend 6 months in the Ekimetrics London team. You’ll work on global client projects to measure and optimise marketing performance through advanced analytics and statistical modelling.
 
You’ll gain first-hand experience as both a data scientist and strategic consultant, using tools like Python and econometric modelling to guide real-world business decisions.
 
You’ll collaborate on client projects and internal R&D from day one. Over the 6-month internship, you’ll also have the opportunity to complete a research project that aligns with your interests and contributes to our broader business goals.
 
Job Responsibilities
1. Data Analytics & Modelling

title: Solutions Engineer - UK (Italian Speaking)
original_description:
😎 Our Culture
Quantum Metric's number one objective is happy people, diverse and inclusive culture.  We’re passionate about empowering our people to become the best version of themselves, offering coaching and training programs designed to accelerate their career in whatever direction they choose.  

As a remote-first company, we understand the importance of building an engaged, diverse, and fun place to work. We hold regular company-wide events, seasonal challenges, and Quantum Metric sponsored local outings when Zoom becomes too much. We also have a number of Employee Resource Groups that provide spaces to discuss, share, and reflect on topics that impact us both inside and outside of work - from being new to SaaS or navigating it as a first-time parent, to overcoming the barriers faced as Black, Hispanic, Asian American and Native Hawaiian/Pacific Islander, LGBTQIA or other underrepresented backgrounds.  

We are also passionate about the connections we build with our customers. You’ll not only work with some of the world’s most recognized brands, but build lasting relationships.

At Quantum Metric we value all types of experience and education and don’t expect you to meet every qualification for this position. We are most interested in the unique perspective you can bring and your ability to uphold our values of passion, persistence, and integrity.

🚀About the Role

As an Enterprise Solutions Engineer (EMEA) at Quantum Metric, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor supporting complex, high-value sales opportunities across the region. Working in close partnership with Enterprise Account Executives, you will engage with large, multinational organizations to help them transform how they understand and optimize digital customer experiences.

In this role, you will guide the technical strategy for enterprise deals, aligning Quantum Metric’s platform with strategic business initiatives. You will connect with diverse audiences—from digital and product teams to C-level executives—positioning Quantum Metric as a critical component of enterprise digital transformation.


🔧 Responsibilities

  • Strategic Advisory: Guide the technical strategy for enterprise sales cycles across EMEA, from initial discovery to closing.

  • Solution Design: Create tailored demonstrations and narratives that align Quantum Metric’s platform with high-level business outcomes.

  • POC Execution: Lead complex proof-of-concepts, defining success criteria and quantifying measurable business value.

  • Technical Architecture: Translate customer needs into scalable solution architectures and clear value propositions.

  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Collaborate with Account Executives on deal orchestration and coordinate with Product/Engineering to ensure smooth post-sales onboarding.

  • Market Influence: Support RFP responses and provide structured customer feedback to influence the product roadmap.


    • 💡Requirements

  • Linguistic Skills: Proficiency in English and Italian; additional European languages preferred.

  • Experience: 4+ years in Enterprise Pre-Sales/Solutions Engineering within the SaaS or software sector.

  • Sales Acumen: Proven success supporting complex, multi-layered sales cycles for large enterprise organizations.

  • Stakeholder Management: Ability to engage both technical teams (architects/developers) and C-suite executives (CIO/CDO).

  • Technical Depth: Hands-on experience with web technologies (JavaScript, HTML, CSS) and ROI-based solutioning.

  • Communication: Exceptional storytelling and presentation skills tailored for diverse corporate environments.

  • Agility: Strong organizational skills to manage multiple strategic deals and a willingness to travel 25–30% across EMEA.

    • Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in Digital Experience Analytics or CXM platforms.

  • Familiarity with agentic AI, enterprise data architecture, or tagging strategies.

  • Background in high-growth SaaS or digital transformation consulting.

    • 💻 Recruitment Process
    Note: This interview process is subject to change. End stage candidates are also given the optional opportunity to meet with an Employee Resource Group Member if that is of interest.
     
    - Recruiter Screen (30 minutes)
    - Take-Home Skills Assessment (30 minutes) 
    - Hiring Manager Interview (60 minutes)
    - Demo (60 minutes)
    - Presentation (60 minutes) 
    - In-person interview (30-90 minutes, subject to interviewer availability) 
    - CEO Interview (30 minutes)

    🏆 Perks & Benefits
    Private Medical Insurance (100% paid)
    Life Assurance 
    Employee Assistance Program 
    Stock Options
    Employee Lead Referral Program
    Internal Lead Referral Program
    One-Time Home Office Enhancement Stipend
    Monthly Business Expense Stipend
    Enhanced Parental Leave
    Company-Wide Unlimited Paid Time Off policy (In addition to company vacation entitlement)
    RECHARGE PROGRAM (after 3 years, disconnect for 3 weeks, no email/slack)
    Automatic enrollment in QM Pension Plan with 4% match 
    MacBook and awesome swag delivered to your door
    Encouraging and collaborative culture
     
    🐉 About Quantum Metric
    As a leader in digital analytics, Quantum Metric helps organizations put customers at the heart of everything they do. Providing a simplified approach to monitor, diagnose and optimize the digital journeys that matter most, the Quantum Metric platform offers in-depth customer understanding, quantified and tied to core business objectives.

    Today, Quantum Metric captures insights from 50 percent of the world’s internet users, supporting nationally recognized brands in ecommerce and retail, travel, financial services and telecommunications. 

    Quantum Metric has been named to the Inc 5000 and the Deloitte 500 for the last six-consecutive years, and has made the Best Places to Work lists by Glassdoor, BuiltIn, Fast Company and Forbes. 

    If the above role seems like a match and you’re interested in joining a team of people with exceptional potential from diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences, we want to hear from you!

    The job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Quantum Metric reserves the right to change, edit, and add duties and responsibilities of all job descriptions at any time, at its sole discretion, and to notify the respective employee accordingly. 

    Quantum Metric will only provide offers of employment and all communications regarding employment from an official ----- address and/or LinkedIn inMail. Quantum does not recruit via channels such as WhatsApp or Telegram, and will not ask for a candidate’s sensitive information and/or any upfront fees/costs during the job application process. title: Android Engineer
original_description:
About Motorway

Motorway is the UK's largest online car-selling platform. We connect private sellers directly with over 8,000 dealers nationwide. Our online platform helps sellers achieve great prices for their cars while giving dealers fast, reliable access to the stock they want for their dealerships. Founded in 2017, our award-winning, technology-led approach has redefined the experience of selling a car. Motorway is backed by some of the world’s leading technology investors, having raised £143 million in Series C funding.

This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing scale-up at a crucial phase of growth and help change an industry for the better.

👋 Hi, I’m Manuele Maggi, Engineering Manager at Motorway. I’m looking for an Android

Engineer to join our Mobile Engineering group and help us build a best-in-class experience

for our Sellers.


This is a great opportunity to join a talented and supportive team, working alongside

engineers, product managers and designers to fundamentally change the way people sell

their car. You’ll contribute to meaningful features used by customers across the UK, develop

your technical skills and explore the latest tools and technologies—with AI increasingly

embedded in how we build and work.

About the role

As an Android Engineer, you’ll take ownership of well-defined features and contribute

throughout the development lifecycle, from early ideas through to release and iteration.


Day-to-day, you’ll be:

  • Collaborating with designers, product managers and other engineers to build high-quality customer experiences.

  • Designing, building and shipping Android features using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose.

  • Contributing to the development of our in-house Server-Driven UI framework, helping us deliver features and dynamic experiences more quickly.

  • Supporting and improving our mobile infrastructure, including CI/CD pipelines with

  • GitHub Actions, Google Play deployment workflows and automated UI testing.

  • Writing clean, maintainable and well-tested code.

  • Participating in code reviews and technical discussions, learning from others while sharing your own ideas.

  • Paying close attention to UI detail, accessibility and the overall app experience.

  • Building an understanding of the backend systems and APIs that power our app.

  • Monitoring released features and helping to resolve issues when they arise.

  • Contributing to the engineering standards and practices used across the Mobile Engineering group.


    About you

  • We’re looking for someone with:

  • Commercial experience building Android applications.

  • Good knowledge of Kotlin and modern Android development.

  • Experience with Jetpack Compose, or an interest in developing your skills with it.

  • An understanding of common mobile development principles, patterns and testing practices.

  • Experience building and releasing features as part of a collaborative product team.

  • The ability to write clear, maintainable and well-tested code.

  • Good collaboration and communication skills.

  • A proactive approach and willingness to take ownership of your work.

  • Curiosity and a genuine desire to continue learning and developing as an engineer.


You could be a great fit if

  • You’ve contributed to reusable components or modules.

  • You enjoy working closely with product and design to solve customer problems.

  • You’re comfortable owning features while asking for support when needed.

  • You care about building polished, reliable and accessible mobile experiences.

  • You’re interested in using modern technologies, including AI, to improve products and engineering workflows.

  • You enjoy sharing ideas, receiving feedback and learning from experienced engineers.

Bonus

  • You don’t need to tick every box, but it would be helpful if:

  • You have experience with Server-Driven UI.

  • You have worked with A/B testing or experimentation.

  • You have some exposure to CI/CD and automated mobile testing.

  • You have integrated ML or AI-powered functionality into an app.

  • You have experience or an interest in backend or full-stack development.

  • You have experience taking a feature from an initial idea through to release.

Location

Hybrid working, with two days a week in our London office and the remainder working from

home.

Our interview process

  • Qualifying Screen — 30 minutes

  • Technical Interview — 60 minutes

  • Soft Skills Interview — 60 minutes, onsite depending on the team


You can expect to hear back from us within a week of each interview stage. You’ll also have

the opportunity to speak with a Talent Partner throughout the process if you have any

questions or require any accommodations.


Benefits

  • We’ve got your back in life’s biggest moments—and the everyday ones too.

  • Competitive salary

  • Equity scheme—we all share in Motorway’s success

  • 25 days’ holiday

  • Flexible working, including two days a week in our London office, with socials and snacks galore

  • Private medical insurance through Bupa

  • Life assurance

  • Pension scheme with a 5% employer contribution

  • Enhanced family leave, including 26 weeks’ full pay for maternity or adoption leave

  • 24/7 Employee Assistance Programme

  • EV leasing scheme

  • Cycle to Work scheme

  • Nursery salary-sacrifice scheme

  • One paid volunteering day each year

title: Senior Backend Engineer, Platform & Integrations
original_description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for backend engineers to build the core systems behind BJAK's insurance comparison platform.

This role is for engineers who can build reliable APIs, workflows and product infrastructure that can scale across markets, partners and millions of users.

What they'll actually do

  • Build the system that connects to multiple insurance providers and requests quotes from all of them at once

  • Design how those quotes get compared fairly and ranked for the customer

  • Build the customer database and the secure audit trail required

  • Set up cloud hosting, CI/CD pipeline, observability and security (encryption, secrets management)

Must-have skills

  • Strong backend development in Node.js / TypeScript (or very close equivalent, e.g. willing/able to work in it)

  • Experience in relational database (PostgreSQL or similar) or non relational database (MongoDB or similar) — not just querying, but designing the schema

  • Experience integrating with third-party APIs, especially handling timeouts, retries, and partial failures gracefully

  • Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and CI/CD pipelines

  • Comfortable working with sensitive customer data and security best practices (encryption, access control)

Strong nice-to-haves

  • Experience in fintech, insurtech, or another regulated industry

  • Experience building a "plugin" or "adapter" style system that needs to support many different external integrations over time

  • Experience with Redis or similar for session/cache management

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in UK. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in UK.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Technical interview

3. CEO / final round


For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Engineering Lead
original_description:
The Role

BJAK builds technology products used by millions of users across Southeast Asia. As our products and systems scale, we need technical leaders who can solve difficult engineering problems and raise the engineering bar around them.

The Engineering Lead owns technical direction and execution for major products and systems. This is a hands-on role - you will design systems, write code, and drive critical engineering work from idea to production.

 

What You'll Own

  • Owning technical design and execution for major products, systems and engineering initiatives.

  • Designing scalable, reliable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Building alongside the team through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Driving architecture decisions and trade-offs across speed, scalability, reliability, cost and maintainability.

  • Turning ambiguous product problems into clear technical solutions and execution plans.

  • Raising engineering quality through stronger system design, testing, security, observability and development practices.

  • Leading technically critical initiatives and mentoring engineers across teams.

 

What We're Looking For

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience building and shipping production systems.

  • Deep expertise in backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills for complex or high-scale systems.

  • Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

  • Track record of technically leading major engineering projects from design through production.

  • Ability to make sound technical trade-offs, influence engineers and solve complex production problems.

 

Nice to have

  • Experience scaling engineering teams, systems or development practices through significant growth.

  • Experience operating across multiple products, markets or countries.

 

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, ADAS
original_description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our ADAS Team

Wayve's ADAS engineering teams build the perception and intelligence that power driver assistance in real-world driving. We work end-to-end, from creating high-quality training data, to developing and evaluating CV/3D perception models, to iterating quickly based on performance gaps. The team mixes "online" (on-car, latency/compute constrained) and "offline" (heavier, large-scale data generation) work, with a strong focus on measurable impact and shipping.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

  • Train, debug, and improve computer vision and 3D perception models, iterating based on clear evaluation signals

  • Work across the full ML lifecycle: data, training, evaluation, and iteration

  • Partner with the team to decide what to tackle next, based on where the system is underperforming

  • Build scalable data pipelines, including auto-labelling and pseudo-labelling, to accelerate model development

     

🧩 What you'll be working on:

  • Core ADAS perception capabilities such as detection, classification, and instance segmentation, spanning lanes, objects, traffic signs, and traffic lights

  • End-to-end approaches that let the model act on the world directly, rather than relying on a chain of hand-coded intermediate steps (lane assist without ever explicitly detecting lane lines is the kind of outcome we're after)

  • Online perception that runs fast in-car as part of our production stack

  • Offline perception work using additional inputs not viable for on-road production, including extra sensors like lidar, future frames, maps, and extra compute, to improve data quality and coverage at scale

  • Building the "data flywheel": using offline models and 3D tracking/reconstruction to auto-generate labels and accelerate iteration across perception tasks

     

👤 You should apply if:

  • Built and shipped CV-focused deep learning systems, with strong applied ML engineering rather than research-only work

  • Experience with 3D perception concepts or pipelines, such as LiDAR, multi-view geometry, tracking, or 3D reconstruction

  • Comfortable owning work end-to-end, including evaluation and large-scale dataset generation

  • Enjoy pragmatic problem-solving under real product constraints

  • Excited to improve real-world driving performance through better perception

  • Automotive domain experience is a bonus, but not a blocker if your perception background comes from elsewhere

🌱 Not ticking every box? That's totally okay! If you're passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every requirement.

 

More about Wayve:

🚗 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve's mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

title: Lead Devops Engineer
original_description:
Waracle are looking for a Lead Devops Engineer for an exciting new role joining our world-class digital technology consultancy and home to a diverse, smart, curious and ambitious community of specialists in technology-driven transformation.

We work with ambitious clients to help them solve their biggest business and customer challenges. We help our clients to innovate and create intelligent digital products and services. We thrive on complex  challenges and deliver business-critical IT transformation projects, moving seamlessly from strategy, design and delivery to operations.

This is a Hybrid role working from our Glasgow, Dundee or London office 2 days a week.

As a Lead DevOps Engineer, you’ll serve as an empathetic leader, strategic advisor, and technical authority across our engineering squads. Bringing a broad, generalist mindset across platform engineering and modern infrastructure, you will lead the integration of AI-driven delivery practices, intelligent automation, and Generative AI tooling into everyday workflows. You will define project-level technical architecture, mentor and lift up growing engineers, and nurture a collaborative, psychologically safe environment where everyone feels empowered to innovate. Balancing short-term delivery with long-term maintainability, you will play a key role in de-escalating conflicts, aligning client stakeholders, and driving high-impact technical strategy aligned with human-centric business goals.

Key aspects of the role include

  • Technical Strategy & AI Integration: Defining technical architecture across squads, anticipating system scaling risks, and driving the adoption of modern AI tooling, MLOps, and intelligent automation within cloud environments.

  • Broad Generalist Leadership: Leveraging your breadth of engineering knowledge to bridge gaps between software delivery, platform operations, and data infrastructure, making complex trade-offs clear and explicit for clients.

  • People & Culture: Creating an inclusive, psychologically safe team environment, regularly coaching team members with constructive feedback, and balancing delivery pace with overall team wellbeing.

  • Standards & Compliance: Guiding teams on performance strategies, proactive optimisation, and security standards (such as OWASP, GDPR, SOC2), ensuring responsible AI practices, clean architecture, and secure code execution.

  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Facilitating workshops to discover requirements, managing project scope and expectations, and translating client priorities into actionable technical strategy.

  • Innovation & Influence: Evaluating emerging AI tools and technical approaches through tech spikes, shaping go-to-market strategies for new offerings, driving delivery tooling improvements, and representing Waracle at external tech events.

Research shows that underrepresented groups tend to only apply for roles that they believe they meet 100% of the criteria for. At Waracle, we want to buck that trend! We hire for passion, potential and mindset as much as credentials. If you think you'd be incredible in the role, then apply - even if you don't think you tick every box.


What you'll bring 

  • A versatile, generalist engineering background with broad knowledge across cloud platforms, CI/CD, containerisation, and infrastructure-as-code.

  • Practical exposure to or enthusiasm for integrating Generative AI, AI-assisted development tools, or modern MLOps pipelines into delivery streams.

  • Proven experience guiding technical direction and architecture for cloud and platform solutions.

  • A passion for mentorship, coaching, and creating supportive pathways for engineers at all career stages.

  • Commitment to fostering inclusive, collaborative team dynamics that prioritise wellbeing alongside quality outcomes.

  • Strong understanding of security, accessibility, and compliance standards (OWASP, GDPR, SOC2) in modern cloud architectures.

  • Excellent communication skills with an aptitude for breaking down complex technical concepts for diverse stakeholders.

  • Familiarity with tracking key engineering metrics (such as DORA) to guide continuous, data-informed improvement.

What to expect from our hiring process

1. First Hello: An informal chat with your dedicated Talent Attraction Partner to talk about Waracle, what you want out of your next move, salary, benefits, and office hybrid working model.

2. Talking Impact: A collaborative deep dive into how you solve problems, work with others, and raise the bar, guided by our core values and competency framework.

3. Craft Showcase: A chance to demonstrate your real-world expertise. Depending on the role, this will be a practical presentation.

Your Talent Attraction Partner will be in your corner through every step right up to your Welcome Ritual on day one

Our Benefits

We believe in supporting our team, inside and outside of work. Here's a glimpse of what you can expect:

  • Rest & Recharge: You'll receive 27 days of annual leave, plus 8 bank holidays, totaling 35 days of holiday to unwind and pursue your passions.

  • Financial Future & Security: Plan for retirement with our company-matched 5% pension contribution. For added peace of mind, we also offer a Death in Service benefit, providing 2 x your annual salary for your loved ones.

  • Health & Wellness: Our Medicash Health Cash Plans help cover everyday healthcare costs, complemented by an Employee Assistance Programme for confidential support, and Group Sickness Cover for peace of mind.

  • Flexible Working: We champion hybrid working, providing a home office setup budget to ensure you're comfortable and productive wherever you are.

  • Learning & Development: Invest in yourself with access to Udemy Business and a dedicated learning and development budget for continuous growth.

  • Lifestyle Perks: Make the most of our Cycle to Work Scheme, and enjoy exclusive gym and retail discounts.

  • Family First: Our enhanced parental leave policies include support for fertility journeys, recognising diverse family needs.

  • Community & Connection: We foster a vibrant culture with regular fun meet-ups and lunch on us in the office once a month. You'll also have the opportunity to make a local impact through Spirit of Waracle, our initiative for getting involved in charitable causes locally, building strong team bonds and giving back.

We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons regardless of their race, gender, disability, religion/belief, sexual orientation or age.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
original_description:
LocalStack - the Local Cloud Sandbox for Developers and AI Agents

We are a fast-growing Series A startup building cutting-edge technology to revolutionize cloud development processes and support highly efficient dev&test feedback loops. We’ve closed our last $25mil round in Q4 2024, led by Notable Capital, CRV and Heavybit.

LocalStack is a local cloud development platform. LocalStack makes it easier, faster, and less expensive for software teams to ship reliable, high-quality applications to the cloud.

The cloud was built to run software, not to support AI-native development workflows. As the world's leading local cloud development platform, LocalStack provides secure local sandboxes that simulate cloud environments, enabling AI agents and software developers to find and fix risks faster and more effectively than they can in the cloud.

Our customer base ranges from SMBs to Global Fortune 500 companies. Our clients include companies like NASA, Harness, IBM, Workday, Comcast, Apple, 3M, Block and many more.

We are sustainably growing our globally distributed teams across GTM, operations and engineering. In 2025 we almost doubled in size and continue to grow across all areas in 2026.

LocalStack is headquartered in Zurich/Switzerland 🇨🇭, with a small engineering office in Vienna/Austria 🇦🇹 and remote team members from 25 countries including 🇺🇸the US, 🇫🇷FR, 🇬🇧UK, 🇨🇦CA, 🇪🇸ES, and many more!

👉Check our Notion Candidate Handbook and our GitHub!

✅ What you will be working on/responsible for

  • Own the internal cloud infrastructure and serve as the primary point of contact for cloud operations and infrastructure requests.

  • Manage and continuously improve our multi-account cloud environment, ensuring security, governance, and compliance best practices are consistently applied.

  • Support and maintain compliance with SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001, ensuring audit evidence is prepared continuously rather than only during audit periods.

  • Operate and improve our identity and access management, including SSO, MFA, permissions, and joiner/mover/leaver processes.

  • Maintain and monitor self-hosted internal services, ensuring they meet agreed service levels and that vulnerabilities are tracked and resolved efficiently.

  • Monitor the security and health of our cloud environment through continuous posture management and proactive risk identification.

  • Own infrastructure cost management for the services under your responsibility and help other teams proactively identify cost or reliability risks before they become issues.

  • Collaborate with engineering teams to improve the reliability, scalability, and operational excellence of our cloud platform.

✅ Experience we expect you to bring to the role

  • Deep AWS experience at org level: Organizations, Control Tower, multi-account landing zones, IAM/SCPs, Security Hub/GuardDuty, VPC and multi-AZ networking

  • IaC as the only way infrastructure gets created - module design, state management, review and promotion between environments. Tool-agnostic, but real depth in at least one (Terraform/OpenTofu, CDK, Pulumi)

  • Understands how to evolve existing systems toward compliance - can look at a running estate and work out what has to change, in what order, to satisfy SOC 2 / ISO 27001. Having been through an audit or certification is a bonus, not a requirement

  • Internal workforce identity and access: IdP-backed SSO/MFA, centralised access management, automated joiner/mover/leaver

  • Self-hosting and operating shared internal tooling that other teams depend on - deploy, upgrade, back up, own the uptime

  • Observability and alerting design, plus on-call for a distributed team

  • Cloud cost management / FinOps fundamentals

  • Azure is a nice-to-have extension, not a requirement - AWS depth is what matters, but the estate is going multi-cloud so appetite for it counts

  • Bash, Python and/or Go for tooling. Comfortable with ambiguity in a remote-first environment, and happy being the first hire in a function

🌱 Values we hold in LocalStack

  • Care: we create with compassion. We prioritize empathy and understanding in every interaction. By genuinely caring for our team, customers, and community, we create an environment where people thrive and impactful work flourishes

  • Ownership: we own the outcome. We take responsibility for our work and are passionate about its impact. We foster autonomy, inspire ambition, encourage ownership, and empower everyone to unlock their potential and make an impact.

  • Openness: we build trust together. We build trust through open communication and honest feedback. By sharing ideas and embracing diverse perspectives, we create stronger, more connected teams that work toward shared goals.

  • Courage: we dare to innovate. We embrace bold challenges and take calculated risks to move the needle. We step outside our comfort zones, experiment fearlessly, and turn setbacks into springboards for growth.

Excellence: we chase the extraordinary. We chase excellence by pushing boundaries and delivering results that go beyond the ordinary, constantly raising the bar and striving for greatness in everything we do. Excellence is not just the outcome, itʼs how we approach every task with purpose, passion, and a commitment to delivering exceptional value.

🎁 Benefits

  • Fully remote

  • Competitive salary

  • Annual company retreat

  • 2 extra company-wide holidays

  • Friendly and inclusive workplace culture (community guilds and online company events)

  • Yearly bonus

Sounds like a good match?

We'd love to hear from you! Join us in shaping the future of cloud development at LocalStack.

To apply, follow the application process. Make sure to include a short motivation outlining why you are the perfect candidate for this role.

If your profile looks like a good match, our talent team will be in touch to organize further steps within 2 weeks.

Please note, that due to a high volume of candidates, we cannot offer personalized feedback to each candidate.

Compensation: £70K – £90K • Multiple Ranges

  • United Kingdom • £70K – £90K
  • Portugal • €42K – €56K
  • Poland • PLN 202K – PLN 330K
  • Spain • €50K – €78K

title: Data Scientist - Credit Cards
original_description:
Data Scientist - Credit Cards

Hybrid in London, United Kingdom

We're looking for a Data Scientist to join the Credit Cards team.

You'll build the credit risk, pricing, and customer lifetime value models behind iwoca's business credit card – who gets a card, with what features, and at what rate.

 

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don't wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that's as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We've already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

iwoca launched its business credit card at the start of 2026. It gives small businesses a fast, flexible way to pay for what they need and control their cash flow, alongside iwoca's loans. The card is a core part of iwoca's long-term growth.

The Credit Cards team builds the card on iwoca's existing lending infrastructure and customer base. The team is made up of commercial strategy product, engineering, operations, and a data scientists.

The role

As a Data Scientist in Credit Cards, you'll do the analysis and modelling for the card's commercial decisions. You'll often have small samples and incomplete data, which suits Bayesian methods. You'll quantify the uncertainty in each estimate and explain what it means for the decision.

You'll run your own projects, from framing the question with the commercial lead to helping the team act on the result. Your models will shape how the card grows. You will be embedded in a broader Credit Cards Team and learn about the product and customer needs. You'll share methods with Credit Risk Modelling, especially where card and lending models overlap, and with data scientists across iwoca in the analytics guild.

Live project examples:

  • Credit limits. Setting initial limits that balance risk with what each customer needs, and designing a framework that adjusts them as spending and repayment data comes in.

  • Pricing. Modelling how interest and fees affect take-up and spending,, to find pricing that works for iwoca and its customers.

  • Customer lifetime value. Estimating activation, spending, and retention from early signals, and updating the estimates as each cohort matures.

  • Card and loan together. Measuring cross-sell and combined credit exposure for businesses that hold both the card and an iwoca loan. Designing the mechanisms to optimise how the two products interact.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Statistical foundations. You have a background in probability and statistics from a quantitative field. You reason about uncertainty and calibration as first-order concerns.

  • Bayesian reasoning. You've used priors, updating, and hierarchical models in real work. You know when a Bayesian model is worth the extra complexity, and when something simpler will do.

  • Analytical ownership. You've taken loosely defined problems from framing the question to a decision the business acted on.

  • Business curiosity. You've used what you learnt about a business's customers and economics to shape your analysis.

  • AI leverage. You've used AI to produce work you couldn't have delivered without it – a prototype, an automation, or a modelling pipeline others use. You judge where it helps and where it doesn't, and you check its output before anyone acts on it.

  • Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail for non-technical colleagues in commercial and strategy roles.

Bonus:

  • Lending experience. You've worked on credit risk, pricing, or customer lifetime value in lending or financial services.

  • Small-sample modelling. You've worked with scarce data and made principled choices about regularisation or sequential updating.

  • Production machine learning. You've taken models from exploration through to deployment and monitoring.

  • Coding in Python. The team works in Python and you’ll write analyses and code in that language.

The salary

We expect to pay from £80,000 to £100,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

  • Interview welcome pack

title: Data Scientist - Broker Terms
original_description:
Data Scientist - Broker Terms Team

Hybrid in London, United Kingdom

We're looking for a Data Scientist to join the Broker Terms team.

You'll shape the analytical approach for a team that sets the terms on iwoca's biggest acquisition channel. The team is young, with many unexplored opportunities.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they ildrive.

The team

Broker Terms is a growing team that sits within iwoca's third-party acquisition department. It owns the full offer terms strategy for customers referred through the broker network – both first-time customers and repeat. The team sets pricing, loan amounts, durations, and broker commissions, and owns the UX that presents them to brokers and customers.

The team is small and interdisciplinary, combining commercial strategy, engineering, and data science. The work translates business questions into quantitative problems, and findings into actionable decisions. Active projects include:

  • Model-based pricing – creating a sophisticated model to offer bespoke pricing to each customer

  • A no-fee test – examining how our product performs when we remove all drawdown fees, and how that influence customer repayment behaviour

  • Testing longer-duration flexi-loan products with particular customer segments.

  • Reintroductions - exploring the right offer terms to give returning customers

The team is small and cross-functional – commercial strategy, engineering, design, and data science – and works across the full application stack, from the Broker API to the Introducer Portal brokers use.

The role

You'll model expected customer take-up rates, design experiments, and translate findings into pricing and product decisions for the acquisition channel that drives the most customer lifetime value (CLTV). Because the Broker Terms team is a young team, you'll influence how its analytical approach develops, not just what it produces.

The work has direct commercial consequences: brokers act on what the team builds and tests, and that shapes which customers iwoca wins and on what terms.

  • Offer terms and experimentation. You'll model how customers respond to offer terms and how brokers make decisions under uncertainty. You'll design experiments where causal inference is central: you'll need to know where standard A/B testing breaks down and what to reach for instead.

  • Commercial translation. You'll work with commercial and strategy colleagues and see your analysis applied directly in day-to-day decisions. That includes meeting brokers in person – gaining context that shapes how you frame and interpret results – and coordinating with adjacent teams responsible for underwriting decisions, repeat lending, and offer construction.

  • CLTV and customer journey. You'll think across the full broker-referred customer journey – from first funding to repeat – identifying what drives CLTV and what changes to offer terms or UX improve it. You own both the strategy and the mechanism, so your findings feed directly into what the team builds and tests.

  • AI and ways of working. You'll use AI to accelerate and automate your analytical work – not occasionally, but as a default. You should have a view on where it genuinely helps and where a different approach is better.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Statistical foundations. You have a background in probability and statistics from a quantitative field such as mathematics, physics, or statistics. You're comfortable with Bayesian reasoning, and have applied hierarchical models or formal decision-making under uncertainty in real work.

  • Causal inference and experimentation. You've separated signal from noise in observational and experimental data. You know where A/B testing breaks down and what to reach for instead. You have experience with careful experimental design to facilitate clean, trustworthy results.

  • Analytical ownership. You take loosely defined problems from start to finish – framing the question, choosing the method, and landing the answer with the people who act on it.

  • Data tooling. You're proficient with data manipulation and modelling tools, and with scientific computing libraries (pandas, numpy, sklearn, PyMC).

  • AI leverage. You've used AI to produce work you couldn't have delivered without it – an analysis pipeline, a prototype, or a tool others use. You judge where it helps and where it doesn't, and you check its output before anyone acts on it.

  • Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail for non-technical colleagues in commercial and strategy roles.

Bonus:

  • Modelling depth. You've built or adapted statistical or ML models and can explain the maths behind them to commercial stakeholders.

  • Stochastic methods. You've used stochastic processes for inference or time-series modelling.

  • Broker market insight. You've worked with brokers or other intermediaries in lending or financial services.

The salary

We expect to pay from £70,000 to £100,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

We're planning this as a six-month secondment. There may be an opportunity to extend it or make it permanent.
