It's small – a product owner and you – and everyone builds. You'll report to the Head of Direct Acquisition, who sets the commercial direction.

The role

As the Applied AI Engineer, you'll build the agents and the systems around them. Most of the work is system design and backend engineering.

You'll start with direct mail. The first goal is an agent that plans each monthly round, uses iwoca's existing predictive models to build the mailing file, and learns from the results as they come in. The pattern is simple to say and hard to get right: the agent orchestrates, deterministic code does the work, and a human in the loop approves the file before it goes to print. You'll work with the people who run each process to understand the edge cases, and with Core Systems and Compliance on access and controls.

The agents don't exist yet, and much is still open: which processes the team takes on, and what the architecture looks like. You'll own those design decisions and write most of the code yourself, much of it with AI coding tools. Some of this won't work, and finding out why is one of the main outputs of the role.

  • Architecture. You'll design what agents need to run reliably: memory that persists between runs, task management, access to tools, permissions, and a record of every decision and why. You'll build each piece so the next process can reuse it.

  • Guardrails. You'll decide where the agent uses judgement and where code enforces rules the agent can't change, like suppressions, compliance checks and budget limits.

  • Delivery. You'll own each agent end to end: connect it to iwoca's predictive models, data pipelines and channel tools, and run it alongside the current process until it has shown it works.

  • Measurement. You'll track how often agents need a person, where they fail, what they cost, and what they're worth.

The requirements

We're looking for the depth of someone who has solved hard problems, and the pace of someone who moves fast in areas that are new to them.

Essential:

  • System ownership. You've owned a complex system end to end, from design to running it in production, and lived with the consequences of your architecture choices.

  • Design judgement. You've made architecture decisions other people built on, and you can explain the trade-offs and what you'd change. When an idea won't work, you say so and offer a better one.

  • Pace. You've got things live quickly in unfamiliar areas and they kept working once people relied on them.

  • Agent engineering. You've built systems where LLMs take actions – more than chat or summaries – and you can explain what went wrong and how you fixed it. You know when a problem needs an agent and when it needs a for-loop.

  • Controls. You've built permissions, data access rules and audit trails into systems from the start.

  • Constructive challenge. You work well with commercial and product colleagues, and when an idea won't work, you say so and offer a better one.

  • AI leverage. You've used AI coding tools to produce engineering work you couldn't have delivered without them – a service, an integration, or an internal tool others use. You have opinions on how to get the most out of them, and you check their output before it reaches production.

  • Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail to your audience.

Bonus:

  • Languages and data tools. You've worked with Python, Go, Snowflake or dbt.

  • Evaluation. You've built evals that measure how an agent performs and where it fails.

  • Marketing and growth tech. You've worked with ad platforms, CRMs or direct mail.

  • Quantitative foundations. You come from a numerical or technical field, such as physics, engineering, maths or computer science.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days' holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we've been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

title: Data Scientist - Third-Party Acquisition
original_description:
Data Scientist - Third Party Acquisition (3PA) - DE

Hybrid in London, United Kingdom

We're looking for a Data Scientist

You'll design experiments and build models that shape how iwoca grows through brokers and partners in Germany. You'll set the approach and see your work open up finance for thousands of small businesses.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don't wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that's as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We've already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

Third-Party Acquisition (3PA) Germany brings small businesses to iwoca through brokers and partners, and owns both journeys end to end – from an application arriving to a business taking up its offer.

The team works across two channels:

  • Brokers. Working with finance advisers who apply to iwoca on behalf of their clients.

  • Partners. Working with platforms, such as digital banks and accounting software, that offer iwoca lending to their own customers.

The team will be nine people across commercial strategy, analytics, product, and engineering.

The role

As the Data Scientist in 3PA Germany, you'll work out what the data says about both channels. Experiment design and statistical modelling on tabular data take up most of your time, with some machine learning. You'll turn what you find into recommendations, and work through them with the team's commercial and product colleagues.

You'll decide which questions are worth answering first, and how to answer them. You'll influence which businesses the team reaches, how they convert, and on what terms.

You'll join the analytics guild – iwoca's data science community – and share methods with data scientists in the UK broker and partner teams, who work on similar questions.

Live project examples:

  • Funnel experiments. Designing and analysing controlled experiments across the broker and partner funnels, including where clean randomisation is hard.

  • Pre-qualification. Developing the model that shows partner customers what they could borrow before they apply.

  • Take-up and lifetime value. Modelling what makes a business take up an offer, and what raises its lifetime value.

  • Competitive position. Working out why businesses that come through brokers and partners choose iwoca over other lenders, and testing changes to the journey that win more of them.

  • Offer terms. Exploring how our lending product terms affect conversion in the broker channel, and using the results to inform product and risk decisions

The requirements

Essential:

  • Statistical foundations. You have a background in probability and statistics from a quantitative field such as mathematics, physics, or statistics.

  • Causal inference and experimentation. You've designed and analysed experiments, and estimated causal effects from observational data. You know where A/B testing breaks down and what to reach for instead.

  • Commercial judgement. You understand the business behind each question, and turn data into recommendations people act on.

  • Analytical ownership. You take loosely defined problems from start to finish – framing the question, choosing the approach, and seeing it through to a decision.

  • Coding for analysis. You write code to explore and model data. The team works in Python, and R is fine to start with.

  • AI leverage. You've used AI to produce work you couldn't have delivered without it – an analysis pipeline, a prototype, or a tool others use. You judge where it helps and where it doesn't, and you check its output before anyone acts on it.

  • Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail for non-technical colleagues in commercial and product roles.

Bonus:

  • Bayesian methods. You understand Bayesian statistics, and you've applied hierarchical models or are keen to.

  • Machine learning. You've built or adapted ML models, and you're curious about the maths behind them.

  • Lending knowledge. You know how lenders price loans or assess credit risk.

The salary

We expect to pay from £70,000 to £90,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

Useful links:

  • iwoca benefits & policies

  • Interview welcome pack

Compensation: £70K – £90K

cleaned_description: div class= content-intro h2 style= font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif; color: #662d91; Teamwork makes the stream work. /h2 p nbsp; /p h3 style= font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif; strong Roku is changing how the world watches TV /strong /h3 p Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we ve set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers. /p p From your first day at Roku, you ll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We re a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines. /p p nbsp; /p /div h3 span data-contrast= none span data-ccp-parastyle= heading 2 About the team /span /span span data-ccp-props= { quot;134233117 quot;:false, quot;134233118 quot;:false, quot;335551550 quot;:0, quot;335551620 quot;:0, quot;335559738 quot;:320, quot;335559739 quot;:140} nbsp; /span /h3 p span data-contrast= auto The Partner Engineering team’s vision is to establish Roku as the preferred platform of choice for our partners (media companies) to distribute and monetize their content globally. The Partner Engineering team’s mission is to be the technical advocate and point of contact for the Partner’s Engineering organization within Roku to help them deliver the best content viewing experience globally for the Roku user community. On a day-to-day basis, we work with engineers from partners organization to help them develop, test, certify, and launch partners direct-to-consumer (DTC) apps in compliance with the Roku platform distribution agreement. We represent partners’ roadmap and technical needs by working cross-functionally with the assigned Partner Engagement Managers, nbsp;product and engineering teams within Roku. /span span data-ccp-props= { quot;134233117 quot;:false, quot;134233118 quot;:false, quot;335551550 quot;:0, quot;335551620 quot;:0, quot;335559738 quot;:0, quot;335559739 quot;:160} nbsp; /span /p p span data-contrast= auto You will be the senior engineer for our European partners: the person who makes their apps fast, stable and certifiable on Roku, who represents their technical constraints to our platform and OS teams, and who makes each new market launch a technical success rather than a scramble. /span span data-ccp-props= { quot;134233117 quot;:false, quot;134233118 quot;:false, quot;335551550 quot;:0, quot;335551620 quot;:0, quot;335559738 quot;:0, quot;335559739 quot;:160} nbsp; title: Senior/Lead Machine Learning Engineer
original_description:
What we are building

Mimica is an AI-powered process intelligence platform enabling enterprises and individuals to reclaim their most precious resource: time. We've all seen repetitive tasks and redundant processes quietly drain productivity and creativity. Not because companies don’t want to become more efficient, but because they don’t know where to start.

Mimica automatically analyzes your team’s work, then generates the AI agents to execute it. Our software turns everyday work into data-backed decisions, helping companies remove process bottlenecks, automate the right tasks, and upskill teams with precision and confidence.

We’ve raised $26 million in Series B financing and are scaling fast. Backed by investors including Khosla Ventures and Paladin Capital, our proprietary AI technology is trusted by Fortune 500 companies to accelerate transformation. Mimica is recognized as a Top 100 AI Start-up by Accel and an industry Leader by the Everest Group.

Our team

Behind our platform is a team of exceptionally talented people, remote-first and globally distributed across 16+ countries. We're looking for curious, collaborative people excited to solve complex problems. You'll join a fast-paced environment built on high ownership, bottom-up thinking, and transparent, open communication – helping some of the world's leading organizations transform the way work gets done with AI.

Our approach to engineering

  • We prioritize customer needs first

  • We work in small, project-based teams

  • We have flexibility in terms of the problems we work on

  • We own the full lifecycle of our projects

  • We avoid silos and encourage taking up tasks in new areas

  • We balance quality and velocity

  • We have a shared responsibility for our production code

  • We each set our own routine to maximize our productivity

 

Your mission

 

You’ll join us as a Machine Learning Engineer/ Data Scientist for Mimica’s Data Intelligence team, whose goal is to transform raw recorded data into clean, structured, anonymized data that powers the work of other teams.

You’ll own key parts of our ML pipelines end to end, making them more accurate, cost-efficient, and trustworthy. Along the way, you’ll build evaluations and LLM judges, run experiments, and transform promising results into validated production improvements.

Your work will be applied and LLM-heavy, with opportunities to evaluate and fine-tune open-source models and build smaller, task-specific models.

If you enjoy taking ML beyond experiments, this is your chance to shape the systems at the heart of Mimica’s products and see your work deliver value to real users at scale.

 

Part of your day-to-day

 

  • Own, debug, and improve production pipelines for accuracy and efficiency.

  • Design, build, and iterate on LLM evals and LLM-as-a-judge systems, including the datasets, metrics, and benchmarks to monitor quality.

  • Run rigorous experiments on prompts, pipeline design, model choice, and inputs (e.g., OCR text vs. image + OCR), and turn the results into clear recommendations.

  • Drive LLM efficiency improvements across our pipelines by comparing models, restructuring steps, and replacing LLM calls with smaller, purpose-built models where it makes sense.

  • Expand our anonymization pipeline, including evaluating and adapting existing models.

  • Work with Python and quality engineers to take experiments into production, and share responsibility for the code you ship.

  • Document findings in writing (eg. experiment reports, design docs)

 

What we’re looking for

 

Primarily, we’re looking for an individual with an experiment- and data-driven researcher mindset with good coding habits. This includes:

  • Solid machine learning/data science background: you understand experimental design, data splits, metrics, bias, and statistical significance, and you know when a result is real.

  • Hands-on experience applying LLMs in production or near-production settings, especially evaluating them: building eval sets, LLM judges and benchmarks, and iterating on prompts and pipelines against them.

  • Comfortable getting deep into messy data: exploring it, troubleshooting issues, and transforming insights into measurable improvements.

  • Strong Python and good engineering skills. You write clear, readable, tested code that others can take to production, even if you’re not the one owning the infrastructure.

  • Able to work independently on ambiguous problems: framing the question, choosing the approach, and deciding on the acceptance criteria to ship.

  • Use AI coding tools effectively and stay accountable for the output: understand, explain, and defend everything you ship.

  • Communicate clearly in spoken and written English, including explaining technical trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences

 

Bonus / Nice to have

  • Experience with classical ML or deep learning model development.

  • Experience with image/OCR pipelines or face-related anonymization

  • Experience shipping end-to-end ML features in a startup or scale-up environment.

 

Location

This is a fully remote position. To make sure we work well together, we’re only considering candidates based in the UK or Europe, in time zones compatible with London (typically UTC-1 to UTC+3).

 

Hiring Process

  • Stage 1. Talent Partner (30-45 min)

  • Stage 2. Take-home challenge (flexible) + Technical Discussion with the team (1h)

  • Stage 3. Technical design exercise and situational questions in session w/ two ML Engineers (1h)

  • Stage 4. Behavioral interview w/ Engineering leadership (1h)

  • Offer

  • Identity Verification

What we offer

💰 Generous compensation + stock options - aligned with our internal framework, market data, and individual skills.

🏢 Distributed work: Work from anywhere - fully remote, in our hubs, or a mix.

💻 Company-issued laptop, remote setup stipend, and co-working budget

📍 Flexible schedules and location

☀️ Ample paid time off, in addition to local public holidays

🍼 Enhanced parental leave

🧘‍♀️ Health & retirement benefits

📖 Annual learning & development budget

🌴 Annual workaways and regular virtual & in-person socials

🌍 Opportunity to contribute to groundbreaking projects that shape the future of work

Note: Some benefits may vary depending on location and role

⚠️ Mimica will only contact candidates from an ----- email address. We do not request banking or sensitive personal information during the recruiting process.

title: Software Engineer, Privacy Engineering (Lawful Access)
original_description:
About the Team

The Privacy Engineering team builds secure, reliable systems that help OpenAI meet its legal obligations while protecting user data. We partner closely with Legal and Engineering teams across OpenAI to support lawful data access requests and other critical legal workflows. Our work turns complex, high-stakes processes into auditable and dependable technical systems with clear human oversight and strong privacy and security controls.

About the Role

We’re looking for a full-stack Software Engineer to build the internal tools and data pipelines that power lawful data access request workflows and Legal Operations. You will work across product and data systems to make authorized retrieval and case handling accurate, efficient, and auditable. This role is well suited to someone who enjoys translating ambiguous operational requirements into durable systems, cares deeply about sensitive-data handling, and wants to improve both technical reliability and the day-to-day experience of the people operating these workflows.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA, with two additional locations under consideration: London, UK, and Dublin, Ireland. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

  • Design, build, and operate backend systems and workflow tooling for the full lifecycle of lawful data access requests, from intake and scoping through authorized retrieval, review, preparation, and audit.

  • Build reliable data pipelines and interfaces across products and data stores so authorized teams can locate and handle the right records accurately and reproducibly.

  • Implement least-privilege access, approval gates, provenance, audit trails, data minimization, and safe failure modes for sensitive workflows.

  • Partner with Legal and Legal Operations to translate legal and operational requirements into clear technical designs and intuitive operator experiences.

  • Identify responsible automation opportunities that reduce repetitive work while preserving human review, judgment, and accountability.

  • Own production systems through testing, observability, incident response, documentation, and continuous reliability improvements.

  • Help define the architecture and roadmap for reusable privacy and legal-infrastructure foundations as OpenAI’s products and obligations evolve.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have experience building or operating systems for lawful data access requests and understand the domain’s legal-process lifecycle, privacy and security constraints, auditability requirements, and operational sensitivities.

  • Strong backend engineering fundamentals and experience building production services or data-intensive systems.

  • Ability to reason carefully about correctness, authorization, security, and privacy when working with sensitive data.

  • A track record of turning ambiguous requirements into pragmatic plans and communicating technical tradeoffs clearly.

  • End-to-end ownership, including operating what you build, and comfort learning unfamiliar products and domains.

  • Care for operator experience and a drive to make complex workflows safer, clearer, and more efficient.

  • Experience collaborating across Engineering, Legal, operations, Privacy, and Security stakeholders.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.

Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this link.

OpenAI Global Applicant Privacy Policy

At OpenAI, we believe artificial intelligence has the potential to help people solve immense global challenges, and we want the upside of AI to be widely shared. Join us in shaping the future of technology.

title: Manager, AI Engineering
original_description:
About SandboxAQ

SandboxAQ is a high-growth company delivering AI solutions that address some of the world's greatest challenges. The company’s Large Quantitative Models (LQMs) power advances in life sciences, financial services, navigation, cybersecurity, and other sectors.

We are a global team that is tech-focused and includes experts in AI, chemistry, cybersecurity, physics, mathematics, medicine, engineering, and other specialties. The company emerged from Alphabet Inc. as an independent, growth capital-backed company in 2022, funded by leading investors and supported by a braintrust of industry leaders.

At SandboxAQ, we’ve cultivated an environment that encourages creativity, collaboration, and impact. By investing deeply in our people, we’re building a thriving, global workforce poised to tackle the world's epic challenges. Join us to advance your career in pursuit of an inspiring mission, in a community of like-minded people who value entrepreneurialism, ownership, and transformative impact.

The Opportunity

The SandboxAQ AI team is looking for a hands-on Manager, AI Engineering to help us build the future of agentic collaboration, trust and ROI. Our goal is to make agents work well on their own, in teams, and with humans. This includes the following aspects:

  • Security: Discovery of agents, evaluation, red teaming, monitoring, guardrails, etc.

  • Quality: Measuring ROI of agents and suggesting improvements

  • Collaboration: Bringing humans and agents together into one place with shared context

A successful candidate thrives at the intersection of AI and software engineering. You deeply understand how models and agents work, how they can fail, how they can be protected and improved. You have hands-on experience with agents in production, know what works and what doesn’t, know the latest trends and you’re opinionated about the future. You know what you don’t know and enjoy learning to close those gaps. You’ll turn your insights and innovation into real world features baked into our platform - shipping code to production.

This is a hands-on leadership role where you’ll break things, fix them and then harden them for good while also leading a small team of engineers. At the same time, you’ll have freedom to explore, collaborate, publish, and deploy, shaping the field of agentic collaboration and trust from all angles. You will help set technical direction, raise the quality bar, mentor team members, and ensure that the team moves quickly from research insight to real-world product impact.

We’re looking for somebody with the curiosity of a researcher, the rigor of an engineer, and the creativity of a hacker. You will be part of a diverse team consisting of ML experts, security experts, mathematicians, and software engineers, each playing a key role in efficient and effective enablement of the cutting-edge technologies being developed at SandboxAQ.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and grow a small, highly technical team while remaining deeply involved in hands-on engineering and research.

  • Set technical direction, break down ambiguous problems, establish practical plans for fast, high-quality execution, and build a culture of ownership, low-ego collaboration, thoughtful experimentation, and high standards.

  • Create new agentic capabilities, including frameworks for monitoring, guardrailing, and evaluating agents, while staying current on the latest agentic developments and identifying new opportunities.

  • Perform classical ML tasks, including exploratory data analysis, feature engineering, and model fine-tuning, and rapidly iterate on prototypes and features based on feedback and evolving product needs.

  • Work closely with Product and Research to translate AI research into applicable features and software engineering projects.

  • Contribute production-ready code and technical designs, working across engineering to deliver scalable, reliable software.

Essential Skills & Experience

  • BSc in Computer Science or related field with exposure to AI/ML.

  • Deep expertise in AI/ML, software engineering, or AI security.

  • Strong programming skills in Python, and relevant ML and/or agentic frameworks.

  • Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally and collaboratively with a high degree of end-to-end ownership, delivering real world outcomes.

  • Ability to pick up other programming languages and technologies as required to ship scalable and reliable software.

Highly Desired Skills & Experience

  • PhD in Computer Science or related field with focus on AI/ML or similar.

  • Hands-on experience with at least one of the following: agent orchestration, agent harnesses, agent teams, jailbreaking / prompt injection, red teaming, data poisoning or evasion attacks, secure model deployment or sandboxing, detection and monitoring for AI misuse.

  • Experience contributing to open source projects.

  • Experience in a fast-paced startup environment.

  • Experience in cybersecurity is a plus, but not essential.

Why Join Us?

We offer a comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to support your health, financial well-being, and life outside of work.

  • Career Defining Work: Your work will directly accelerate the discovery of better drugs and better materials, advance human health, and enable safer and more sustainable technologies by helping customers put AI Simulation capabilities into real world use.

  • Compensation: Competitive base salary, performance-based incentives or bonuses (where applicable), and equity participation.

  • Benefits: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents with generous employer premium contributions, retirement savings with company matching, paid parental leave, and inclusive family-building benefits.

  • Work-Life Balance: Fully remote, Flexible paid time off, company-wide seasonal breaks, and support for flexible work arrangements that enable sustainable performance.

  • Learning and Growth: Opportunities for continuous learning and growth through on-the-job development, cross-functional collaboration, and access to internal learning and development programs.

SandboxAQ Welcomes All

We are committed to fostering a culture of belonging and respect, where diverse perspectives are actively sought and valued. Our multidisciplinary environment provides ample opportunity for continuous growth - working alongside humble, empowered, and ambitious colleagues ready to tackle epic challenges.

Equal Employment Opportunity: All qualified applicants will receive consideration regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status.

Accommodations: We provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities in job application procedures for open roles. If you need such an accommodation, please let a member of our Recruiting team know.

Compensation: £85K – £150K • Multiple Ranges

  • UK Tier 1 • £100K – £150K
  • UK Tier 2 • £85K – £128K

Join us to advance your career in pursuit of an inspiring mission, in a community of like-minded people who value entrepreneurialism, ownership, and transformative impact. The Opportunity The SandboxAQ AI team is looking for an AI Engineer to help us build the future of agentic collaboration, trust and ROI. Our goal is to make agents work well on their own, in teams, and with humans. This includes the following aspects: Security: Discovery of agents, evaluation, red teaming, monitoring, guardrails, etc. Quality: Measuring ROI of agents and suggesting improvements Collaboration: Bringing humans and agents together into one place with shared context A successful candidate thrives at the intersection of AI and software engineering. You deeply understand how models and agents work, how they can fail, how they can be protected and improved. You have hands-on experience with agents in production, know what works and what doesn’t, know the latest trends and you’re opinionated about the future. You know what you don’t know and enjoy learning to close those gaps. You’ll turn your insights and innovation into real world features baked into our platform - shipping code to production. This is a hands-on role where you’ll break things, fix them and then harden them for good. At the same time, you’ll have freedom to explore, collaborate, publish, and deploy, shaping the field of agentic collaboration and trust from all angles. We’re looking for somebody with the curiosity of a researcher, the rigor of an engineer, and the creativity of a hacker. You will be part of a diverse team consisting of ML experts, security experts, mathematicians, and software engineers, each playing a key role in efficient and effective enablement of the cutting-edge technologies being developed at SandboxAQ. Key Responsibilities Create new agentic capabilities - frameworks for monitoring, guardrailing, and evaluating them, and to make them work together more effectively. Perform classical ML tasks - exploratory data analysis, feature engineering and fine-tuning models using the latest frameworks. Work closely with Product and Research to translate AI research into applicable features and software engineering projects. Rapidly iterate on prototypes and features based on feedback and evolving product needs. Contribute production ready code, working across engineering to deliver scalable software. Stay on the edge of the latest agentic developments and explore new opportunities. Essential Skills Experience MSc in Computer Science or related field with exposure to AI/ML. Deep expertise in AI/ML, software engineering, or AI security. Strong programming skills in Python, and relevant ML and/or agentic frameworks. Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally and collaboratively with a high degree of end-to-end ownership, delivering real world outcomes. Ability to pick up other programming languages and technologies as required to ship scalable and reliable software. title: Senior Analytics Engineer
original_description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

Overview

This critical role sits at the intersection of Data Engineering and Data Analytics, focusing on transforming raw data into high-quality, trustworthy, and easily consumable datasets and visualisations for business users. The ideal candidate will possess a strong background in SQL, dbt, data modelling, ETL/ELT principles and experience with modern cloud data platforms.

Core Responsibilities

Develop and Maintain Transformation best practices in ELT Pipelines: Design, develop, and maintain efficient and scalable workflows using tools like dbt to transform raw data loaded into our data warehouse (Snowflake) into clean, ready-to-use data models.

Data Modelling: Implement best-practice data modelling and software engineering techniques to ensure data structures are optimised for performance, accuracy, and ease of use in reporting and analytical applications (e.g. CI/CD, testing, lineage).

Data Quality and Testing: Write comprehensive data quality checks, tests, and monitoring scripts to ensure the accuracy, completeness, and reliability of all transformed data assets. Establish and maintain documentation for all data transformations and models.

Collaboration: Work closely with Data Analysts and business users to understand their reporting needs and optimise data models to support their analytical use cases. Collaborate with Data Engineers on data ingestion strategies and platform optimisation.

Performance Optimisation: Tune and optimise SQL queries and data models to reduce latency and improve the performance of our data warehouse and downstream applications.

Tool Adoption: Champion the adoption of modern data stack tools and practices (e.g. Git, CI/CD).

Build scalable, compelling data visualisations in Looker that can be used by large teams.

Required Qualifications

  • Experience: Multiple years of experience in a data-focused role (e.g., Analytics Engineer, Data Analyst, BI Developer).

  • SQL Mastery: Expert-level proficiency in writing and optimising complex SQL queries.

  • Data Transformation Tooling: Hands-on experience with dbt (Data Build Tool) or similar data transformation frameworks is essential.

  • Data Warehousing: Experience working with cloud-based data warehouses such as Snowflake, Google BigQuery, or Amazon Redshift.

  • Data modelling: Solid understanding of data warehousing concepts, ETL/ELT principles, and dimensional modelling techniques.

  • Version Control: Proficiency with Git for collaborative development and version control.

  • Familiarity with reporting/ BI tools like Looker.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Python expertise for automation, integration, and orchestration

  • Experience with Semantic layers

  • Experience with orchestration tools like Airflow.

  • Knowledge of modern software engineering practices applied to data (e.g., modularity, code review, testing).

Our Vision is for a world where TravelPerk serves as the platform for human connection in-real-life (IRL). We take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our London or Barcelona hub. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in-real-life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

TravelPerk is a global company with a diverse customer base—and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at TravelPerk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

title: Senior Data Engineer
original_description:
📍 Manchester (Hybrid, up to 4 days WFH) | 💰 £55k-£70k


Street Group is one of the fastest-growing PropTech companies in the UK. We want to be the leading creator of delightful experiences for everybody involved in buying, selling, renting and letting property, regardless of their involvement, to improve the industry for everybody by elevating UK Estate Agencies through world-class technology.

Our products, Street.co.uk and Spectre, form a powerful duo, working harmoniously together to transform an agent's job. From securing more leads and winning new instructions to streamlining business operations and growing market share, our products are supercharging 1,000s of agencies across the UK.


How we work in 2026

Engineering at Street Group has changed. Most of us don't write code by hand day-to-day anymore - agents do; we direct. The bar has moved with it; planning and judgement matter more than typing speed.

Being genuinely tuned into AI tooling is core to the role here, not a side skill - and if you'd rather work the "old" way, that's fair - but we're probably not the place for you.

Our Data team builds and runs the data platform behind both products. That means sourcing property data, scraping the property portals with our in-house tool Road, and serving it all through Kraken, our UK property data API. Terabytes of data move through the platform every night, and since we launched a new version of Road there’s more to do than ever. Nobody owns a single pipeline, so you’ll flex across all of it. At this level, the platform is yours to steer: you won’t just build things well; you’ll decide how they should be built, and call it out when the way we’ve always done it is no longer the right way.


If you love autonomy, are naturally curious, and want to have a genuine impact within a growing company, we think you'd fit right in!

Here's what you can expect to be working on as a Senior Data Engineer (L5) at Street Group

  • Owning data work end to end - from working out whether the data exists, through ingestion and modelling, to getting it to the teams who need it.

  • Building high-volume pipelines and ETL with performance, reliability and cost in mind and keeping up as sources, schemas and data sets change underneath you.

  • Running the platform our pipelines run on, our own Kubernetes cluster and deployment tooling and helping decide what we host, what we pay for and what we retire.

  • Setting the patterns, tooling and code review standards that make the whole team faster, including the Claude skills and MCP servers we rely on.

  • Being the go-to for questions about our data, what we hold, where it comes from and what it can (and can’t) tell people.


A bit about you

  • You have strong commercial experience with Python and SQL - you know a good query from a bad one, and you've built ETL at scale with performance and cost in mind. BigQuery experience is a big plus.

  • You have production experience with Google Cloud Platform.

  • You have hands-on platform experience with containers, Kubernetes and Helm. You don't need to write charts from scratch, but you've changed them and deployed them yourself.

  • You work AI-natively as a default, using tools like Claude Code, plugins and skills fluently, and you're always experimenting with what's next. (If your current employer limits AI at work, tell us what you're doing with it outside work - we'd love to hear about it.)

  • You enjoy creative problem solving, when data is too expensive or doesn't exist, you find your own way to get it.

  • You communicate clearly in writing, design docs, RFCs and explaining the decisions you've made.

  • Bonus points for Go, Terraform, API design, managing a large SQL database or BI exposure. No property experience needed!


Why join Street Group?

🏠 Hybrid-working - you can work from home up to 4 days per week
🏖️ Guilt-Free R&R - £1000 towards a holiday after your first year with the team (we'll even cover the tax!)
💪 Joining a culture that supports your development and encourages growth
📚 £500 yearly L&D budget for your career development
🎂 Your birthday on us - we pay, you stay away
🙋 'Give something back' - 2 paid days volunteering on us
👶 Enhanced maternity, paternity & adoption pay
🧠 Mental health & well-being support via Health Assured
🧘 Regular well-being initiatives
🕒 Flexible working hours
🚂 Public transport season ticket loans
🌷 Paid menopause leave
🌞 Holiday buying scheme
🚀 Joining a new team in an exciting business with huge ambition
👥 Be a part of something bigger - everyone in our team is passionate about improving the entire property industry! It's a huge goal, but it motivates us to do better every single day
👩🏿‍💻 A chance to work on cutting-edge technology
🐶 Comfortable, relaxed office space - office dogs welcome!
🍻 Fully stocked fridge and beers (or an alternative) on us every Friday afternoon
🎊 Company and team off-sites, events and happy hours
🚴 Cycle to work scheme
🚗 Electric car salary sacrifice scheme
🌍 Feel good about sustainability - we're a climate-positive company!

Research has shown that women tend to rule themselves out of applying for jobs unless they meet 100% of the requirements. If you fall into that category and were about to rule yourself out based on the above criteria; please consider applying anyway. We'd love to see your application!

Salary

£55,000 - £70,000 dependent on experience. However, sometimes the perfect person is far more or less experienced than we anticipated. In these situations, planned ranges go out the window. If you think that might be the case, please apply and just let us know.

We care deeply about helping the tech industry become a more inclusive and diverse place and we work hard to lead by example. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a complementary team of employees and building an inclusive environment for all. Candidates must be eligible to live and work in the UK and be able to perform the work specified.


Interview Process

🕧 4 stages (incl. tech task) = An introductory call with one of our Talent team > Take-home tech task > Technical Interview > Final interview.

We want to make our interviews as inclusive as possible, so if you need any adjustments made, or if there's anything you think we should be aware of during the interview process, please do let us know.


A note on using AI in your job application

As a fast-moving and rapidly evolving tech company, we embrace the advantages of AI and encourage its use throughout our application process. However, our goal is to get to know and hire the authentic you - your skills, experience, and values. We don't want to hire an AI-generated version of you. We consider AI to be a valuable tool, not something that should overshadow you as an individual.


How we use AI in the hiring process

Candidate experience is really important to us, and our Talent team use AI notetakers during interviews so they can focus purely on their conversation with you. All hiring decisions are made by people, not AI.

Compensation: £55K – £70K

  • Data Engineer L5 • £55,000 - £70,000 £55K – £70K

location: Addlestone, Richmond upon Thames, United Kingdom
original_description:
Are you an experienced IT professional looking for a hands-on role within an international technology organisation? Our client is an established Managed Service Provider delivering IT support and infrastructure services to a range of well-known businesses.

They are looking for a proactive and technically capable engineer who is comfortable working directly with customers, resolving technical issues and supporting IT environments both remotely and on customer premises.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide technical assistance to customers and act as a trusted point of contact for support matters.

  • Visit customer sites to investigate and resolve technical issues, perform installations and undertake planned maintenance.

  • Manage incidents, requests and ongoing technical tasks through the Service Desk system.

  • Provide customers with regular updates and ensure tickets are progressed within agreed SLAs.

  • Escalate critical, complex or high-priority issues to Management when appropriate.

  • Organise daily workloads and ensure urgent and important tasks are dealt with accordingly.

  • Monitor customer environments and infrastructure to ensure systems remain reliable and meet business requirements.

  • Install, configure, test, maintain and repair IT hardware, software and related systems.

  • Maintain accurate ticket information and document technical work and outstanding actions.

  • Respond to major incidents and priority issues both remotely and at customer locations.

Benefits

  • £30,000 - £40,000 per annum, depending on experience.

  • 40 days' paid holiday annually.


The ideal candidate will have a minimum of 5 years' experience in a similar IT engineering role, with practical knowledge of:

  • Cyber Essentials and GDPR security standards, including configuration and implementation (mandatory).

  • Microsoft 365 services, including Email, SharePoint, Teams and OneDrive (mandatory).

  • Microsoft Intune, RMM solutions and telephone platforms.

  • Network infrastructure installation and support, including routers, switches, wireless APs, DHCP, DNS, TCP/IP, firewalls and VLANs.

  • Working with external suppliers and service providers to resolve technical requirements.

  • Applying appropriate IT procedures, controls and industry best practices.

  • Windows Server 2016, 2019 and 2022, including Group Policy and security policies.

  • Azure administration and implementation.

  • Windows 10, Windows 11 and Mac operating systems.

  • Building, imaging and configuring different customer environments.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and a professional customer-facing manner.

  • The ability to analyse issues, troubleshoot effectively and work independently.

  • A collaborative approach and the ability to contribute as part of a wider team.

title: Staff Software Engineer
original_description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

As a Staff Backend Engineer, you'll take technical ownership of complex business domains, designing, building, and evolving scalable, reliable backend services for our enterprise spend management platform.

What you'll be working on:

  • Designing and operating distributed systems, event-driven architectures, and cloud-native services.

  • Applying Domain-Driven Design (DDD) to model complex business domains and define clear service boundaries.

  • Building maintainable systems following Clean Architecture, Hexagonal Architecture, and similar architectural principles.

  • Designing APIs, service integrations, and reliable asynchronous workflows using technologies such as Temporal.

  • Designing secure authentication and authorization solutions, applying standards such as OAuth 2.0, OIDC, and WebAuthn, as well as fine-grained authorization models.

  • Ensuring scalability, security, observability, and resilience in production.

  • Continuously improving shared libraries, project structure, development tooling, and automated quality assurance practices to promote consistency, reusability, and maintainability across services.

  • Driving architectural decisions, evaluating trade-offs, and mentoring other engineers.

  • Leveraging AI extensively but responsibly, including developing guardrails, agent harnesses, and tooling to maintain engineering quality in a fast-paced environment.



We primarily use Node.js with TypeScript, but strong engineering fundamentals matter more to us than experience with a particular language. Our technology stack also includes Temporal, SpiceDB, PostgreSQL, Kafka, and Redis.

This is a 80/20 hands-on technical leadership role, combining deep engineering work with architectural ownership and influence across teams.
Remote, but travel to Amsterdam or other offsite meetings in Europe might occasionally be requested

Your colleagues would say you

  • Lead by example and raise the bar with pragmatism and care.

  • Communicate clearly, listen well, and bring people along in decisions.

  • Enjoy breaking down complex problems, gathering input, and driving to a solution.

  • Coach others and create space for people to grow.

  • Prefer progress over perfection, while still caring deeply about quality.

 

Show me the benefits

  • Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

  • Lunch is on us - with catering in our Lisbon, Copenhagen and London offices or a monthly lunch allowance paid directly together with your salary in other markets

  • Private health insurance to ensure you’re fit in body and mind to do your best work

  • Wellbeing days - fully paid days off designed for a slower pace, allowing you to take time to recharge and prioritise self-care

  • We provide access to MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and wellbeing support with great success so far

  • Access to LinkedIn Learning - acquire new skills, stay abreast of industry trends and fuel your personal and professional development continuously

  • Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

title: AI Ops Engineer (Business Operations)
original_description:
About Kernel

Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this?

Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier.

Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust.

Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent Kernel ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. Ops, data and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva and Notion already use Kernel on their own systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them.

We have raised $20M from top VCs and operators at Plaid, OpenAI, Slack and others, and we are growing 10x YoY.

The Role

We’re looking for an AI Ops Engineer to build the internal systems that help Kernel scale without adding unnecessary manual work. You’ll work across GTM, Marketing, Customer Success and Operations - finding the highest-leverage problems and building practical AI-powered workflows.

This is a hands-on builder role. You’ll take ideas from a vague business problem to a tool or workflow that people use, then maintain and improve it in production. You’ll choose the fastest sensible approach for each problem - coding agents, automation platforms, APIs, data pipelines or lightweight code.

You’ll report to Arvin Ashrafi, Head of Finance & Operations, and partner closely with GTM, Marketing, and Customer Success leadership.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Define how an AI-native company operates: help build Kernel’s internal playbook for using AI across GTM, Marketing, Customer Success and Operations

  • Make our GTM team more productive: automate the repetitive work in prospecting, account research, meeting prep and CRM hygiene, so BDRs, AEs and Account Managers spend more time with customers

  • Build internal tools and workflows: use coding agents, APIs, automation platforms, no-code tools or lightweight code

  • Turn company data into operational leverage: connect and improve data across our systems, then put it to work in AI agents, proactive workflows and better decision-making

  • Put AI agents to work across Kernel: give teams agents with the right context, tools and guardrails so they can move faster without sacrificing judgement or reliability

  • Be Kernel’s own internal customer: deploy Kernel on Kernel’s CRM, improve our GTM data and turn what you learn into useful feedback for Product and Engineering

  • Level up the team: help colleagues become confident AI users, document what works and turn successful experiments into repeatable ways of working

Your First 6 Months

For your first six months, you’ll focus on our sales team. You’ll sit with our BDRs, AEs and Account Managers and learn how they work day to day. Then you’ll automate everything that doesn’t need a human. That means going deep on Salesforce and our GTM stack, and owning the RevOps workflows behind them. After that, you’ll bring the same approach to Marketing, Customer Success and Operations.

What You Bring

title: Senior AI/ML Engineer
original_description:
Take ownership of the AI behind our clinical products in the US: an AI therapist delivering end-to-end care, and AI assessment used by healthcare providers.

About Limbic

Limbic’s vision is to ensure the highest quality therapy is accessible to everyone, everywhere.

Limbic has supported more than 820,000 patients across the UK and the US. We are used in over 50% of NHS Talking Therapies services, which makes us the largest-ever deployment of generative AI for direct patient care, and our AI now delivers end-to-end therapy to patients in the US under the supervision of licensed clinicians.

Safety and science come first. We are the only AI mental health chatbot with UKCA Class IIa medical device certification, and the first AI-led mental healthcare company selected for the FDA’s TEMPO pilot. Our results are published in leading scientific journals: in a randomised, double-blind trial published in Nature Medicine, our AI agents scored higher than licensed CBT therapists on a standard measure of therapy skill.

The Role

As a Senior AI/ML Engineer, you have demonstrated experience in AI product development and will take ownership of translating AI research into products that tangibly improve patients’ lives. You will join one of our two product teams building for the US market, and we will work with you to find the one where your strengths have the most impact:

  • AI therapy: a voice agent delivering structured CBT over the phone to adults with depression and anxiety, with licensed clinicians overseeing care. It is live with Medicare patients and growing every week.

  • AI assessment: a conversational agent that US healthcare organisations configure to assess patients, administer clinical questionnaires, detect risk and recommend the right treatment programme, so patients reach the right care faster.

Both teams build on shared platforms for agents, evaluation and safety, so the systems you design are reused across the company, and you will be expected to bring your successes cross-product.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the AI quality of a live clinical product end to end, from framing problems with clinicians and product managers to shipping, monitoring and improving in production.

  • Design and build agentic systems, including orchestration of specialised agents, tools and memory, that stay fast enough for real-time voice and text conversations.

  • Build and improve the safety systems that screen every patient message and every AI reply, from real-time risk detection to guardrails against unsafe or clinically inappropriate responses.

  • Lead eval-driven development: evaluation suites, simulated patients and LLM-as-judge autolabellers validated against clinician labels, so we ship with confidence and catch regressions before patients do.

  • Productionise ML models that optimise product KPIs, such as triage accuracy, treatment completion and recovery rates, and identify the causal factors that drive them.

  • Help turn our clinical AI into composable services that healthcare partners can integrate into their own patient journeys.

  • Raise the engineering bar through architecture, code review and mentorship, while keeping our AI continuously compliant with strict regulatory requirements.

What You’ll Bring

  • You must meet one of the following educational and experience backgrounds:

    • A PhD in computational science or an AI-related field, plus 2 years of experience in an ML engineering role.

    • OR A BSc/MSc, plus 4 years of experience in an ML engineering role.

  • Expertise in productising LLM features and a strong background in eval-driven development.

  • Expert-level proficiency in Python and TypeScript/JavaScript.

  • Proven experience building an LLM agent harness.

  • Experience utilising reinforcement learning.

  • Strong architectural skills with experience designing scalable, production-grade systems for machine learning applications.

  • A solid understanding of statistical principles in the context of LLM evaluation and user activity analytics.

  • Proficiency with version control systems (preferably Git) and databases (SQL or NoSQL).

  • Hands-on experience with a major cloud platform and containerisation technologies.

  • A track record of end-to-end ownership: you scope work you can ship quickly, measure its impact, and keep a sense of urgency when the stakes are high.

  • A genuine interest in applying your technical skills to solve complex challenges in the mental healthcare space.

  • Ideal but not required: Experience with real-time voice AI, or with healthcare organisations as customers.

  • The ability to work from our London (Spitalfields) office on Tuesdays and Thursdays, with the flexibility to work remotely or from the office on other days of the week. As you will work on products for the US, expect some meetings in the late afternoon UK time.

  • We can consider visa sponsorship for candidates relocating to London.

Benefits & Wellbeing

  • Competitive salary and equity share options.

  • An amazing office in central London (Spitalfields) for our collaborative team days on Tuesdays and Thursdays, paired with a flexible/hybrid working model on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays.

  • 25 days PTO plus bank holidays.

  • Company pension scheme (UK).

  • Enhanced parental leave packages (UK).

  • Support with purchasing work-related books and materials.

  • Quarterly Life Days: Enjoy 4 paid days off per year (one each quarter) to use whenever you choose to relax, recharge, or take care of personal matters.

  • Mental Health Support: Access to dedicated mental health support services.

We encourage women and individuals from diverse backgrounds to apply and join our team. We believe in creating an inclusive and supportive work environment where everyone can contribute their best.

title: AI/ML Engineer
original_description:
Build the AI therapist that delivers end-to-end CBT to patients in the US: live, clinically supervised, and measured on whether people actually get better.

About Limbic

Limbic’s vision is to ensure the highest quality therapy is accessible to everyone, everywhere.

Limbic has supported more than 820,000 patients across the UK and the US. We are used in over 50% of NHS Talking Therapies services, which makes us the largest-ever deployment of generative AI for direct patient care, and our AI now delivers end-to-end therapy to patients in the US under the supervision of licensed clinicians.

Safety and science come first. We are the only AI mental health chatbot with UKCA Class IIa medical device certification, and the first AI-led mental healthcare company selected for the FDA’s TEMPO pilot. Our results are published in leading scientific journals: in a randomised, double-blind trial published in Nature Medicine, our AI agents scored higher than licensed CBT therapists on a standard measure of therapy skill.

The Role

As an AI/ML Engineer, you will sit at the intersection of computational psychiatry, clinical science, and software engineering. You will join the product team building our AI therapist: a voice agent that delivers structured, evidence-based CBT over the phone to adults with depression and anxiety, with licensed clinicians overseeing every patient’s care.

The product is live and growing week on week, so your work reaches real patients quickly. You will own problems end to end: frame them with clinicians and product managers, ship a change, measure whether it helped, and iterate. Our AI products are built on shared platforms for agents, evaluation and safety, so what you build here is reused across Limbic.

What You’ll Do

  • Improve how our AI therapist runs sessions, from session structure and case formulation to therapeutic techniques and continuity across a course of treatment, working closely with clinicians.

  • Strengthen the safety systems that protect patients in real time, including risk detection and how the agent responds when risk is disclosed.

  • Build evaluations and LLM-as-judge autolabellers, validated against clinician labels, so we know quickly and reliably whether a change made care better or worse.

  • Make voice conversations feel natural: responsive, well-paced, and able to recover gracefully when a conversation goes off script.

  • Help patients stay with their treatment long enough to recover, through AI features such as well-timed session reminders and clear expectations about what therapy involves, and test what works with experiments.

  • Optimise how we collect outcome measures such as PHQ-9 and GAD-7, including the methods, timing and predictive modelling of recovery.

  • Ship changes safely through incremental rollouts, automated testing and a clinical sign-off process built for a regulated medical device.

What You’ll Bring

  • You must meet one of the following educational and experience backgrounds:

    • A PhD in Computational Psychiatry or a related field, coupled with demonstrated industry experience in Data Science, Product, or ML engineering.

    • OR A BSc/MSc in a Computational Psychiatry related field (research focus) plus 2 years of experience in ML engineering or Data Science within an Engineering/Product Development environment.

  • Proficiency in either Python or TypeScript/JavaScript.

  • Experience building LLM-powered features and a track record of eval-driven development.

  • An expert approach to hypothesis-driven work, with a track record of balancing product development with scientific rigour.

  • Experience using Machine Learning in a production environment or via high-impact scientific publications (e.g., predictive modelling, reinforcement learning).

  • Experience modelling text/language data, including building LLM classifiers and using vector-based methods.

  • Experience modelling longitudinal data and working with databases (SQL or NoSQL).

  • A strong understanding of evidence-based mental health care (such as Cognitive Behavioural Therapy) and a deep interest in the causal mechanisms that drive therapeutic benefit.

  • A bias to action: you break big problems into pieces you can ship within a week, and you are comfortable making decisions with incomplete information.

  • Proficiency with version control systems, preferably Git.

  • Ideal but not required: Experience building an LLM agent harness or real-time voice AI.

  • The ability to work from our London (Spitalfields) office on Tuesdays and Thursdays, with the flexibility to work remotely or from the office on other days of the week.

Benefits & Wellbeing

  • Competitive salary and equity share options.

  • An amazing office in central London (Spitalfields) for our collaborative team days on Tuesdays and Thursdays, paired with a flexible/hybrid working model on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays.

  • 25 days PTO plus bank holidays.

  • Company pension scheme (UK).

  • Enhanced parental leave packages (UK).

  • Support with purchasing work-related books and materials.

  • Quarterly Life Days: Enjoy 4 paid days off per year (one each quarter) to use whenever you choose to relax, recharge, or take care of personal matters.

  • Mental Health Support: Access to dedicated mental health support services.

We encourage women and individuals from diverse backgrounds to apply and join our team. We believe in creating an inclusive and supportive work environment where everyone can contribute their best.
